title: Woman and man hospitalized after 2 stabbings minutes apart in Syracuse
summary: Two stabbing incidents occurred within 30 minutes in Syracuse early Monday morning (August 3, 2026), resulting in critical injury to a man and hospitalization of a woman. The first incident was reported at 1 a.m. in the 500 block of East Willow Street. This public safety incident involves Syracuse Police Department response.
